set.body: Authorized next tranche: adaptive quadratic/cubic stroke ribbons with bounded device error and dash arc-length error; explicit cusp refusal; paint-independent glyph coverage and linear gradient text; bounded device-owned image/mask resource reuse across recordings with upload/rasterization counters, eviction and pinned retirement. Preserve kernel semantics and prior receipts. Four-scale independent geometry/pixel references, replacement/scale/disposal/generation checks and full JVM/Native matrix required.
set.title: G-2: bounded curved strokes, gradient glyph masks and shared GPU assets
